content: This paper presents a new method for simultaneously selecting important features and performing classification when dealing with longitudinal healthcare data (such as from wearable devices) where features change over time and outcomes are categorical. The approach uses an efficient algorithm based on functional principal components and sparse optimization techniques, allowing it to handle high-dimensional datasets and successfully identify relationships between chronic diseases and various health/demographic factors.
